blocks.text: SCHEDULE: Gilas Pilipinas at Fiba Asian Qualifiers Window 5 MANILA, Philippines–When national team duty calls, Troy Rosario is the guy always ready to answer. That was the case for the fifth window of the Fiba World Cup 2027 Asian Qualifiers, when an injury to Rhenz Abando prompted Gilas Pilipinas to call up Rosario for another stint with the national team. Rosario accepted, but at the cost of cutting short a pre-planned family vacation in Ilocos Norte. “[Gilas Pilipinas assistant coach Richard del Rosario] texted me while we were heading to Ilocos but I wasn’t able to get a hold of his […]...
